description:
See what changed at a company, and when: versions with the fields that changed (address, status), each with its official source.
Use it for changes over time. Don't use it for the current state: call lookup_company.
Inputs: country FR or ES or GB; identifier as for lookup_company (441639465); optional id_scheme; page.
Returns: versions newest first with source, fetched_at and the fields changed; dated events where the source has them (BORME acts, Companies House filings). meta.history_since says where history starts.
Limits: 1 unit; keyless 20 units a day. Read-only. France: from Fuentio's first fetch of the company. Spain: from 2 January 2009. United Kingdom: the latest filings, and every change since Fuentio first held it.
Search words: historique, historial, cambios, due diligence.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

detail.description: summary: a few key fields; standard (default): the record, long lists shortened; full: everything.
detail.title: Detail

id_scheme.description: Optional: force the ID type when it is ambiguous.
id_scheme.title: Id Scheme

name: get_company_history
title: See what changed at a company
